Legal &
claim standard.

ThinkAnas Health is presented as a founder-led independent professional practice led by Anas Senhaji. Definitive contracting identity, jurisdiction, registration and billing information must be stated in the applicable proposal and agreement.

Professional information

This website provides general information about architecture, integration and AI-governance services. It is not medical, clinical, legal, cybersecurity or regulatory advice.

Standards and platforms

References to HL7, FHIR, NPHIES, Malaffi, Nabidh, cloud environments or security methods describe potential architectural contexts and technical capabilities. They do not imply certification, endorsement, approval, live connectivity or commercial partnership.

Engagement outcomes

Timelines such as “90-day pilot” are indicative working models, not guaranteed delivery commitments. Scope, feasibility, dependencies, clinical validation and measurable outcomes are agreed during discovery and contracting.

Public evidence

Credentials and portfolio references are labelled by type. A portfolio or academic project is not presented as a production client deployment. External profile information may change and should be verified on the linked public source.

Clinical safety and accountability

ThinkAnas Health’s stated design principle is that consequential clinical decisions remain under authorised human control. Any production implementation requires the client’s clinical, security, legal and regulatory approval processes.

نتائج المهمة

المدد مثل «تجربة 90 يوماً» نماذج عمل استرشادية وليست التزاماً مضموناً. يتم الاتفاق على النطاق والجدوى والاعتماديات والتحقق السريري والنتائج القابلة للقياس خلال الاكتشاف والتعاقد.
